[b]Daddy, looks like the Multiverse is a concept you know frighteningly little of![/b]

A brilliant but flawed scientist discovers a way to travel the multiverse. His family, consisting of his affection-deprived wife, an athletically gifted son, and a prodigious daughter, inadvertently get themselves entangled in an impromptu adventure spanning infinite parallel realities with no clear way home. Will their escapades across limitless, diverse universes teach them what it truly means to be family?

[b]In an unlimited Multiverse, there are limitless possibilities![/b]
